_doc: The objective and key results the fleet is ranked against (docs/VISION.md in the product repo, set by Reif 2026-09-14). A Vision-link on an issue must name one of these ids or say `none (maintenance)`; prose that names no id is not a link (Reif 2026-09-16: OKRs were set and still nothing bound the pick to them). `metric` is the console tile (scripts/metrics.json) that reads the KR, or null while the baseline is not yet pulled. Override per instance with FLEET_OKR_FILE.

key_results.label: Traffic: weekly search-driven visits to org pages
Clicks: distinct orgs clicking the claim CTA, per 30 days
Conversion: claim CTA click to claim filed
